args.command: shopt -s globstar nullglob; for n in User Memo Attachment Reaction Inbox UserSetting MemoRelation MemoShare IdentityProvider; do c=0; files=""; for f in **/*.go; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; case "$f" in store/*|*_test.go) continue;; esac; if awk -v n="$n" 'index($0,"store." n){found=1} END{exit !found}' "$f"; then c=$((c+1)); files="$files $f"; fi; done; printf '%s %d%s\n' "$n" "$c" "$files"; done
